coverLetterDrafts.draft:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to express my interest in the Software Developer, New Grad position at IXL Learning. With a solid foundation in programming principles and a passion for educational technology, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to a company that is making a significant impact on learning outcomes.

I recently completed my Advanced Diploma in Computer Programming at Seneca Polytechnic, where I gained hands-on experience in Java, JavaScript, and various web development technologies. As a Junior Developer at the Seneca Software Developer Club, I collaborated with a team of over ten members to develop web applications using TypeScript, JavaScript, and REST APIs. This experience not only honed my technical skills but also fostered my ability to work in a collaborative environment, a value I understand is central to IXL Learning's culture.

I am particularly drawn to IXL Learning because of its commitment to innovation in education. I admire the recent features introduced in 2023 that enhance user engagement and learning outcomes. I am eager to bring my skills in software development and my enthusiasm for education to your team, helping to design, implement, and refine integrations and internal tools that support your mission.

I am confident that my diverse technical skills, coupled with my strong communication and teamwork abilities, make me a suitable candidate for this role. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to the continued success of IXL Learning.

Thank you for considering my application. I hope to speak with you soon.

Sincerely,
Krutin Polra

Dear Hiring Manager,

I am excited to apply for the Software Developer, New Grad position at IXL Learning. With a strong technical background in Java, JavaScript, and web development, I am eager to contribute to your innovative team.

During my time as a Junior Developer at the Seneca Software Developer Club, I led the development of several web applications, including a dynamic website for our club that improved member engagement by 40%. My experience with technologies such as TypeScript, REST APIs, and databases like MongoDB and MySQL has equipped me with the skills necessary to design and implement robust solutions. I am particularly proud of my work on an interactive web application that utilized The Met’s public API, showcasing my ability to integrate external data sources effectively.

At IXL Learning, I see an opportunity to leverage my skills in a fast-paced, agile environment. I am particularly drawn to the challenge of developing and refining integrations and internal tools that enhance educational outcomes. I am eager to bring my problem-solving abilities and collaborative spirit to your team, contributing to projects that make a real difference in the field of education.

Thank you for considering my application. I am looking forward to the possibility of discussing how my background and skills align with the goals of IXL Learning.

Best regards,
Krutin Polra
